record.oneLiner: A tiny, chicken-sized carnivorous theropod of the Late Jurassic.
record.description: Compsognathus was a small, bipedal carnivore about the size of a chicken from the Late Jurassic of Europe. It is one of the few dinosaurs whose diet is known for certain — the remains of small, agile lizards are preserved in the bellies of both known specimens. It was long the smallest known non-avian dinosaur.

notableFacts.text: About the size of a chicken — long the smallest known non-avian dinosaur.
Its last meals — small lizards — are preserved in its stomach.
